description: Stage a valid local PNG through the helper and embed it in the Mac workbook.
declarations: Dim testSheet As Worksheet, oldActiveSheet As Object
Dim oldFormula As Variant, pictureType As Long, pictureVisibility As Long
Dim macPicture As Shape, cleanupPicture As Shape, pictureMetadata As String, plotted As Variant
check: CStr(result) = "Chart" And pictureType = msoPicture And pictureVisibility = msoTrue And Left$(pictureMetadata, Len("SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf & "J20" & vbLf)) = "SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf & "J20" & vbLf
expected_text: Chart result and a newly embedded Mac picture tied to J20, with the requested visible state.
result_details: "Mac Shape.Type=" & CStr(pictureType) & "; Visible=" & CStr(pictureVisibility) & "; Metadata=" & pictureMetadata
cleanup: If Not cleanupPicture Is Nothing Then
If Left$(cleanupPicture.AlternativeText, Len("SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf)) = "SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf Then cleanupPicture.Delete
coverage_note: Mac stores the chart as an embedded worksheet object with a basic text note; the cell menu controls visibility. This checks object type, ownership and visibility, without Comment.Shape.Fill. HTTP diagnostics describe the last SMF data request, not this image.

description: Verify the local numeric chart handles constant values.
declarations: Dim testSheet As Worksheet, oldActiveSheet As Object
Dim oldFormula As Variant, pictureType As Long, pictureVisibility As Long
Dim macPicture As Shape, cleanupPicture As Shape, pictureMetadata As String, plotted As Variant
check: CStr(result) = "Chart" And pictureType = msoChart And pictureVisibility = msoTrue And Left$(pictureMetadata, Len("SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf & "J20" & vbLf)) = "SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf & "J20" & vbLf And testSheet.ChartObjects(macPicture.Name).Chart.SeriesCollection.Count = 1 And CDbl(ArrayCell(plotted, 1, 0)) = 50 And CDbl(ArrayCell(plotted, 2, 0)) = 50 And CDbl(ArrayCell(plotted, 3, 0)) = 50
expected_text: Chart result and a newly embedded Mac line chart tied to J20, with the requested visible state.
result_details: "Mac Shape.Type=" & CStr(pictureType) & "; Visible=" & CStr(pictureVisibility) & "; Metadata=" & pictureMetadata & "; Series=" & CStr(ArrayCell(plotted, 1, 0)) & "," & CStr(ArrayCell(plotted, 2, 0)) & "," & CStr(ArrayCell(plotted, 3, 0))
cleanup: If Not cleanupPicture Is Nothing Then
If Left$(cleanupPicture.AlternativeText, Len("SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf)) = "SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf Then cleanupPicture.Delete
coverage_note: Mac renders the supplied numeric series locally. Positive values are normalized to integers 1..98; nonpositive values become 0; equal positive values become 50. No ogres-crypt.com request occurs.

description: Remove the calling cell's chart and note when its ticker becomes NONE.
declarations: Dim testSheet As Worksheet, oldActiveSheet As Object
Dim oldFormula As Variant, pictureType As Long, pictureVisibility As Long
Dim macPicture As Shape, cleanupPicture As Shape, pictureMetadata As String, plotted As Variant
call_steps: If CStr(testSheet.Range("J20").Value) <> "Chart" Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1902, "Mac picture NONE", "The initial picture did not load"
check: CStr(result) = "None" And macPicture Is Nothing And testSheet.Range("J20").Comment Is Nothing
expected_text: None result after a valid picture; the previous picture and note must both be absent.
cleanup: If Not cleanupPicture Is Nothing Then
If Left$(cleanupPicture.AlternativeText, Len("SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf)) = "SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf Then cleanupPicture.Delete
coverage_note: Mac stores the chart as an embedded worksheet object with a basic text note; the cell menu controls visibility. This checks object type, ownership and visibility, without Comment.Shape.Fill. HTTP diagnostics describe the last SMF data request, not this image.

description: Reject a nonimage HTTP200 body and remove the previous picture, so an old image cannot pass as the new result.
declarations: Dim testSheet As Worksheet, oldActiveSheet As Object
Dim oldFormula As Variant, pictureType As Long, pictureVisibility As Long
Dim macPicture As Shape, cleanupPicture As Shape, pictureMetadata As String, plotted As Variant
call_steps: If CStr(testSheet.Range("J20").Value) <> "Chart" Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1903, "Mac failed picture update", "The initial picture did not load"
check: CStr(result) = "Error" And macPicture Is Nothing And InStr(1, pictureMetadata, "not a PNG", vbTextCompare) > 0
expected_text: Error result for HTTP200 text, no previous picture, and a note identifying the invalid image response.
cleanup: If Not cleanupPicture Is Nothing Then
If Left$(cleanupPicture.AlternativeText, Len("SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf)) = "SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf Then cleanupPicture.Delete
coverage_note: Mac stores the chart as an embedded worksheet object with a basic text note; the cell menu controls visibility. This checks object type, ownership and visibility, without Comment.Shape.Fill. HTTP diagnostics describe the last SMF data request, not this image.
